summary: The market is thin today. Austin Health's Grade 2 psychologist role in Heidelberg is the only clear, current Grade 2 role close to home, and most other ads were closed, Grade 3, mixed-grade or too vague to confirm. Check Austin and the Neami role first.
criteria: Grade 2 roles within 25 km of Eltham VIC 3095
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (AHPRA general + clinical endorsement)
15+ years: community mental health, acute inpatient, complex care
2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader supervising staff
Clinical Psychologist, Emble Allied Health (private), since 2023
Risk assessment, complex formulation, individual and group therapy, MDT work, supervision
CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, mindfulness-based, trauma-informed
Eltham; north and north-east are easy commutes, west and south-east are long

jobs.employer: Not named in the ad (possibly Eastern Health)
jobs.why: The role is open to Grade 2 psychologists, as well as Grade 3 RPNs, OTs and social workers. It is case management rather than a pure therapy role. The employer's own ad could not be found, so it is unverified.
